Ai.title: Suggestions that are tied to your work — not generic advice.
Ai.body: MARSA uses your project context to propose next steps, questions to answer, and risks to consider — so you keep moving without guesswork.
Ai.whyBody: AI output is framed as a concrete action tied to your model and numbers — so it's easy to execute.
suggestions: Your value proposition is clear — now validate pricing with 5 quick customer calls this week.
Your burn rate implies ~6 months runway. Consider narrowing scope or adding a pre‑sale offer.
Your acquisition channel is broad. Pick one: LinkedIn outbound or partnerships — then define a weekly target.
